testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change magnification with the mouse wheel ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid visible in the active part in the MCAD Software ✔ And no navigation command is active ✔ When the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the direction that zooms out ✔ Then the block appears smaller in the viewport ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ When the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the opposite direction ✔ Then the block appears larger than after zooming out ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active
